entries.en: The caretaker plans to board up the broken windows before winter.
entries.zh: 管理员计划在冬季前用木板封住破窗。

entries.en: The fence's wooden boarding had warped after years of rain.
entries.zh: 围栏的木板结构经过多年雨淋后变形了。

entries.en: The attendant checked my boarding card at the gate.
entries.zh: 工作人员在登机口检查了我的登机证。

entries.en: The boarding house provided breakfast at a long communal table.
entries.zh: 这家寄宿处在一张公用长桌上供应早餐。

entries.en: The boarding school kept its dining hall open during examinations.
entries.zh: 考试期间，这所寄宿学校保持食堂开放。

entries.en: The boatbuilder shaped a replacement plank for the fishing boat.
entries.zh: 造船者为渔船加工了一块替换木板。

entries.en: The lake attracts visitors who enjoy boating on quiet mornings.
entries.zh: 这片湖吸引着喜欢在宁静早晨划船游玩的游客。

entries.en: She secured the loose strand with a bobby pin.
entries.zh: 她用发夹固定住了那绺散发。

entries.en: The team pushed the bobsleigh toward the start of the icy track.
entries.zh: 队员们把长橇推向冰道的起点。

entries.en: The reviewer criticized the bodice ripper for romanticizing sexual violence against its heroine.
entries.zh: 评论者批评这部艳情小说美化了针对女主人公的性暴力。

entries.en: The physiology lecture examined temperature regulation as a bodily function.
entries.zh: 生理学讲座将体温调节作为一种人体生理功能加以探讨。

entries.en: The speech called for rebuilding trust across the body politic.
entries.zh: 这篇演讲呼吁在整个国家政治共同体内重建信任。

entries.en: The dancer wore a plain body stocking beneath the costume.
entries.zh: 舞者在演出服下面穿了一件素色连身紧身衣。

entries.en: The discussion could bog down if every detail requires a vote.
entries.zh: 如果每个细节都需要投票，讨论可能会陷入停顿。

entries.en: Let the sauce boil down before adding the vegetables.
entries.zh: 先让酱汁熬浓，再加入蔬菜。

entries.en: The laboratory worksheet asks students to record the liquid's boiling point.
entries.zh: 实验室练习表要求学生记录液体的沸点。

entries.en: The bolshy apprentice refused to follow even the simplest instructions.
entries.zh: 那个不愿合作的学徒连最简单的指令也不肯听从。

entries.en: The manager introduced mentoring to bolster up the inexperienced team.
entries.zh: 经理引入了指导制度，以支持并巩固这支经验不足的团队。

entries.en: We had to bolt down our sandwiches before the bus arrived.
entries.zh: 公交车到来前，我们不得不狼吞虎咽地吃掉三明治。

entries.en: A faded bomber jacket hung on the dressing room wall.
entries.zh: 一件褪色的短夹克挂在更衣室墙上。

entries.en: The archive contains photographs of the harbor before the bombing.
entries.zh: 档案中有港口遭轰炸前的照片。

entries.en: Her final bon mot made even the stern chairperson smile.
entries.zh: 她最后那句妙语连严肃的主席都逗笑了。

entries.en: The dealer supplied documents proving that the painting was bona fide.
entries.zh: 经销商提供了证明这幅画是真品的文件。

entries.en: Mind your bonce when you enter that low doorway.
entries.zh: 从那道矮门进去时，当心脑袋。

entries.en: The technician inspected the bonding between the two metal sheets.
entries.zh: 技术人员检查了两块金属板之间的结合情况。

entries.en: The antique shop displayed a bone china cup on velvet.
entries.zh: 古董店将一只骨灰瓷茶杯陈列在天鹅绒上。

entries.en: The soil beneath the shelter was bone dry after the storm.
entries.zh: 风暴过后，遮蔽物下的土壤仍完全干燥。

entries.en: The anatomy model uses yellow material to represent bone marrow.
entries.zh: 解剖模型用黄色材料表示骨髓。

entries.en: The exhausted character insists that the noisy house is driving him bonkers.
entries.zh: 那个疲惫的角色坚持说，吵闹的房子快把他逼疯了。

entries.en: The memoir recalls evenings spent watching the boob tube after work.
entries.zh: 回忆录讲述了下班后看电视度过的夜晚。

entries.en: The last team received a wooden spoon as a booby prize.
entries.zh: 最后一名的队伍得到一把木勺作为末名奖品。

entries.en: The band secured a three-night booking at the seaside hotel.
entries.zh: 乐队获得了在海边酒店演出三晚的预约合同。

entries.en: The booking clerk found us two seats on the earlier train.
entries.zh: 售票员帮我们在较早的那班火车上找到了两个座位。

entries.en: Someone carried a boom box into the outdoor rehearsal area.
entries.zh: 有人把一台大型手提式录音机带进了室外排练区。

entries.en: The documentary follows recruits during their first month at boot camp.
entries.zh: 纪录片跟拍了新兵在训练营的第一个月。

entries.en: The reunion ended with a noisy booze-up at the pub.
entries.zh: 重聚最后变成了酒馆里一场喧闹的酒宴。

entries.en: The carpenter used a hand drill to bore a small hole.
entries.zh: 木匠用手钻钻了一个小孔。

entries.en: A born storyteller, she could hold the whole room's attention.
entries.zh: 她是个天生的讲故事能手，能吸引全屋人的注意。

entries.en: The interview describes the writer's life as a born-again Christian.
entries.zh: 访谈描述了这位作家作为一名重生基督徒的生活。

entries.en: The council discussed borrowing to finance the new library building.
entries.zh: 市政委员会讨论了借款资助新图书馆大楼建设的问题。

entries.en: She looked bothered when the missing documents were mentioned.
entries.zh: 提到遗失的文件时，她显得很烦恼。

entries.en: We took the empty jars to the bottle bank.
entries.zh: 我们把空玻璃罐送到了玻璃瓶回收站。

entries.en: He tends to bottle up his frustration until meetings are over.
entries.zh: 他往往把沮丧压抑到会议结束。

entries.en: The uniforms included bottle-green jackets with silver buttons.
entries.zh: 制服包括配有银色纽扣的深绿色夹克。

entries.en: A bouncing puppy greeted every visitor at the gate.
entries.zh: 一只活泼的小狗在门口迎接每位访客。

entries.meaningZh: 为领赏而追捕逃犯的人
entries.en: The western features a bounty hunter tracking a fugitive across the desert.
entries.zh: 这部西部片描写了一名为领赏而追捕逃犯的人在沙漠中追踪目标。

entries.en: The actor had to bow down before the throne.
entries.zh: 演员必须在王座前屈身低头。

entries.en: He borrowed a silk bow tie for the awards dinner.
entries.zh: 他借了一条丝绸蝴蝶结领结参加颁奖晚宴。

entries.en: The bowed branch formed a low arch over the path.
entries.zh: 那根弓形树枝在小路上方形成了一道低矮的拱。

entries.en: The comedian balanced a bowler hat on the umbrella handle.
entries.zh: 喜剧演员把一顶圆顶礼帽平衡着放在伞柄上。

entries.en: Our team celebrated the end of term with an evening of bowling.
entries.zh: 我们队用一晚的保龄球活动庆祝学期结束。

entries.en: The bowling alley offered discounted games on quiet weekday mornings.
entries.zh: 这家保龄球场在清闲的工作日上午提供打折场次。

entries.en: The groundskeeper mowed the bowling green before the afternoon match.
entries.zh: 场地管理员在下午比赛前修剪了草地保龄球场。

entries.en: Parked vans threatened to box in the small delivery truck.
entries.zh: 停着的货车有可能把那辆小型送货车围住。

entries.en: Please quote the box number when replying to the advertisement.
entries.zh: 回复广告时请注明信箱号。

entries.en: The runner was boxed in behind three competitors near the bend.
entries.zh: 在弯道附近，那名跑者被夹在三位对手后面。

entries.en: The club offers boxing lessons in the converted warehouse.
entries.zh: 俱乐部在改建的仓库里开设拳击课。

entries.en: The crew checked the ropes around the boxing ring.
entries.zh: 工作人员检查了拳赛场地周围的围绳。

entries.en: The old modem's label gives its maximum speed in bps.
entries.zh: 那台旧调制解调器的标签以每秒比特数标明了其最高速度。

entries.en: A bracing breeze greeted us at the top of the hill.
entries.zh: 我们到了山顶，迎面吹来一阵令人振奋的微风。

entries.en: The basket had a braided handle made from pale reeds.
entries.zh: 篮子有一个用浅色芦苇编成辫状的提手。

entries.en: The report links the region's brain drain to limited research funding.
entries.zh: 报告将该地区的人才流失与研究资金有限联系起来。

entries.en: The stall sold branded shoes alongside unmarked canvas bags.
entries.zh: 摊位上同时出售带商标的鞋和没有标记的帆布包。

entries.en: The public branding of the workers as disloyal damaged their reputation.
entries.zh: 公开给工人们打上不忠的烙印损害了他们的声誉。

entries.en: The regiment's brass band played near the memorial after the parade.
entries.zh: 阅兵结束后，该团的铜管军乐队在纪念碑附近演奏。

entries.en: The test increased the load until the cable reached its breaking point.
entries.zh: 测试不断增加载荷，直到缆绳达到断裂点。

entries.en: Waves crashed against the breakwater beyond the fishing boats.
entries.zh: 海浪拍打着渔船外侧的防浪堤。

entries.en: He kept the folded ticket in his coat's inner breast pocket.
entries.zh: 他把折好的票放在外套内侧的胸袋里。

entries.en: The training video shows an officer preparing to breathalyze a driver.
entries.zh: 培训视频展示了一名警员准备对司机进行呼气酒精检测。

entries.en: The singer paused to breathe in before the final phrase.
entries.zh: 歌手在最后一个乐句前停下来吸了一口气。

entries.en: The quiet recording captured the actor's breathing between lines.
entries.zh: 那段安静的录音录下了演员在台词之间的呼吸声。

entries.en: The extension gave the team some breathing space before the deadline.
entries.zh: 延期让团队在截止日期前有了一点喘息时间。

entries.en: The rider brushed dust from the knees of his breeches.
entries.zh: 骑手掸去了马裤膝部的灰尘。

entries.en: The research farm keeps detailed records of plant breeding.
entries.zh: 研究农场保存着详细的植物育种记录。

entries.en: The protected island is a breeding ground for several seabirds.
entries.zh: 这座受保护的岛屿是几种海鸟的繁殖地。

entries.en: The brethren gathered in the chapel before the evening meal.
entries.zh: 教友们在晚餐前聚集到了小礼拜堂。

entries.en: The museum explains brewing through models of old copper vessels.
entries.zh: 博物馆通过旧铜制容器的模型讲解酿酒过程。

entries.en: The mantelpiece was crowded with bric-a-brac collected on their travels.
entries.zh: 壁炉台上挤满了他们旅行时收集的小摆设。

entries.en: The owners decided to brick up the unused cellar entrance.
entries.zh: 业主决定用砖封住不用的地窖入口。

entries.en: The bride-to-be chose wildflowers for the table decorations.
entries.zh: 准新娘选了野花来装饰餐桌。

entries.en: The bridle path follows the stream beyond the farm.
entries.zh: 骑马专用道沿着农场外的小溪延伸。

entries.en: The crew attended a detailed briefing before the rescue exercise.
entries.zh: 救援演习前，队员们参加了一场详细的情况简报会。

entries.en: The archive labels the uniform as belonging to a brigadier general.
entries.zh: 档案将这套制服标注为属于一位准将。

entries.en: Both performers took temporary jobs to bring home the bacon.
entries.zh: 两位表演者都靠做临时工作谋生。

entries.en: The child carefully opened a broad bean pod in the garden.
entries.zh: 孩子在花园里小心地剥开了一个蚕豆荚。

entries.en: She moved from newspaper reporting into local radio broadcasting.
entries.zh: 她从报纸报道转向了当地电台广播工作。

entries.en: We were broke after paying for the emergency repairs.
entries.zh: 付完紧急维修费后，我们身无分文了。

entries.en: A broken latch kept the cupboard door from closing properly.
entries.zh: 一个坏掉的门闩让柜门无法正常关上。

entries.en: The song describes a broken heart without naming the lost lover.
entries.zh: 这首歌描写了心碎，却没有说出失去的恋人的名字。

entries.en: The anatomy instructor pointed to a bronchial tube on the model.
entries.zh: 解剖学教师指着模型上的一根支气管。

entries.en: The swimmer placed her bronze medal beside the team photograph.
entries.zh: 游泳运动员把铜牌放在了队伍合影旁。

entries.en: His bronzed face contrasted with the pale collar of his shirt.
entries.zh: 他晒成古铜色的脸与浅色衬衫领形成了对比。

entries.en: The portrait captures a brooding poet beside an unlit fireplace.
entries.zh: 这幅肖像描绘了一位在未点燃的壁炉旁沉思的诗人。

entries.en: My sister and brother-in-law arrived together for the family picnic.
entries.zh: 我的姐妹和她的丈夫一起来参加家庭野餐。

entries.en: The passengers were browned off after another unexplained delay.
entries.zh: 再次遭遇没有解释的延误后，乘客们都烦透了。

entries.en: The committee could not brush aside the residents' safety concerns.
entries.zh: 委员会不能漠视居民对安全的担忧。

entries.en: I need to brush up my French before the exchange visit.
entries.zh: 交流访问之前，我需要复习提高一下法语。

entries.en: The reporter received a brusque brush-off at the reception desk.
entries.zh: 记者在接待处遭到了生硬冷淡的拒绝。

entries.en: The brushed cotton lining felt soft against the wrist.
entries.zh: 拉绒棉衬里贴着手腕，感觉很柔软。

entries.en: The child wanted a bubble bath after the muddy walk.
entries.zh: 在泥泞中走完路后，孩子想洗个泡泡浴。

entries.en: A packet of bubble gum lay beside the comic books.
entries.zh: 一包泡泡糖放在漫画书旁。

entries.en: We watched small pockets of air bubble up through the water.
entries.zh: 我们看着小团空气从水中冒泡升起。

entries.en: The historian compared several city records describing outbreaks of bubonic plague.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了几份描述腺鼠疫暴发的城市记录。

entries.en: The coach urged the disappointed players to buck up before the next match.
entries.zh: 教练敦促失望的队员们在下一场比赛前振作起来。

entries.en: We need to buckle down if the exhibition is to open tomorrow.
entries.zh: 如果展览要在明天开幕，我们就得全力以赴地工作。

entries.en: The prize helped a budding novelist find a publisher.
entries.zh: 这个奖帮助一位初露头角的小说家找到了出版商。

entries.en: The angry character tells the unwanted visitor to bugger off.
entries.zh: 那个生气的角色叫不受欢迎的访客走开。

entries.en: The old building now houses a community music school.
entries.zh: 这栋旧建筑如今是一所社区音乐学校的校舍。

entries.en: The mason lifted a building block onto the fresh mortar.
entries.zh: 泥瓦匠把一块建筑用块材放在新铺的砂浆上。

entries.en: A temporary fence surrounded the empty building site.
entries.zh: 临时围栏围住了那片空的建筑工地。

entries.en: The archive preserves a building society's first membership register.
entries.zh: 档案馆保存着一家建房互助协会最早的会员名册。

entries.en: The rehearsal schedule is pinned to the bulletin board.
entries.zh: 排练时间表钉在布告栏上。

entries.en: The documentary examines how bullfighting is portrayed in old posters.
entries.zh: 纪录片研究了旧海报如何描绘斗牛表演。

entries.en: The extra material will bump up the cost of each costume.
entries.zh: 额外的材料会提高每套演出服的成本。

entries.en: The child chose a red bumper car near the entrance.
entries.zh: 孩子选了入口附近一辆红色碰碰车。

entries.en: Please do not bunch up around the narrow doorway.
entries.zh: 请不要挤在狭窄的门口周围。

entries.en: We should bundle up before heading out into the snow.
entries.zh: 我们应该穿暖和些再出门到雪地里去。

entries.en: A bungling thief left a glove beside the broken window.
entries.zh: 一个笨拙的窃贼把手套落在了破窗旁。

entries.en: The hostel placed a bunk bed against each side wall.
entries.zh: 旅舍靠两侧墙壁各放了一张双层床。

entries.en: The volunteers cut bright bunting into triangles for the celebration.
entries.zh: 志愿者们把鲜艳的旗布剪成三角形，用于庆祝活动。

entries.en: The burdened donkey stopped beside the steepest part of the trail.
entries.zh: 驮着重物的驴停在小路最陡的地方旁边。

entries.en: The shopkeeper tested the burglar alarm before locking up.
entries.zh: 店主锁门前测试了防盗警报器。

entries.en: The old theater could burn down if the fire reached its wooden roof.
entries.zh: 如果火烧到木屋顶，那座旧剧院就可能被烧毁。

entries.en: The dry paper would burn up quickly in the stove.
entries.zh: 干纸在炉子里很快就会烧光。

entries.en: A burned-out warehouse stood at the edge of the harbor.
entries.zh: 一座被烧毁的仓库矗立在港口边缘。

entries.en: The exhibit compares the burning of different candle materials.
entries.zh: 展览比较了不同蜡烛材料的燃烧情况。

entries.en: The camera recorded a delivery van entering the bus lane.
entries.zh: 摄像机录下了一辆送货车驶入公交车专用道的画面。

entries.en: We were completely bushed after carrying the boxes upstairs.
entries.zh: 把箱子搬上楼后，我们累坏了。

entries.en: For the museum guide, visiting galleries became a busman's holiday.
entries.zh: 对那位博物馆导览员来说，参观画廊成了仍做日常工作的假日。

entries.en: The partners stopped speaking after a bust-up over the accounts.
entries.zh: 合伙人为账目大吵一架后就不再说话了。

entries.en: The designer paired a velvet bustier with a long skirt.
entries.zh: 设计师将一件天鹅绒紧身胸衣与长裙搭配。

entries.en: It is difficult to finish a story when you constantly butt in.
entries.zh: 你总是插话，让人很难讲完一个故事。

entries.en: The gardener opened a pod and examined a butter bean.
entries.zh: 园丁打开豆荚，检查了一颗利马豆。

entries.en: He tried to butter up the editor before requesting an extension.
entries.zh: 他在请求延期前试图奉承编辑。

entries.en: A button-down shirt hung neatly beside the borrowed jacket.
entries.zh: 一件领尖有纽扣的衬衫整齐地挂在借来的夹克旁。

entries.en: The report describes a buyer's market with many unsold apartments.
entries.zh: 报告描述了一个存在大量未售公寓的买方市场。

entries.en: A buzzing lamp disturbed the otherwise silent reading room.
entries.zh: 一盏嗡嗡响的灯打扰了原本安静的阅览室。

entries.en: By rights, the last ticket should go to the person who arrived first.
entries.zh: 按理，最后一张票应当给最先到的人。

entries.zh: 他们那艘可住宿的游艇停泊在游艇码头的加油泊位旁。

entries.zh: 我们在一家小餐馆停下来喝茶、吃吐司。

entries.zh: 橱柜里有一盒预拌蛋糕粉和一袋未开封的面粉。

entries.en: Her calculated pause made the audience lean forward expectantly.
entries.zh: 她有意安排的停顿让观众满怀期待地向前倾身。

entries.zh: 教练在训练前带领大家做了一小段健身操。

entries.en: Teaching became her calling after several years as a volunteer tutor.
entries.zh: 做了几年志愿辅导老师后，教书成了她的职业。

entries.en: The visitor left a calling card with the receptionist.
entries.zh: 访客在接待员那里留了一张名片。

entries.zh: 这本旧训练手册以配有插图的健身操动作开篇。

entries.en: The excited crowd began to calm down after the announcement.
entries.zh: 广播通知后，激动的人群开始平静下来。

entries.zh: 这项历史研究讨论了一位向士兵提供性服务的营妓。

entries.zh: 一位独自露营的人在松树下搭起了帐篷。

entries.zh: 露营地入口旁有一个水龙头。

entries.en: The can opener was hidden beneath the kitchen towels.
entries.zh: 开罐器藏在厨房毛巾下面。

entries.en: Her can-do attitude helped the team tackle the unexpected repairs.
entries.zh: 她积极进取的态度帮助团队着手处理了意料之外的维修。

entries.en: A narrow flat-bottomed canal boat carried timber through the lock.
entries.zh: 一艘狭长的平底运河船载着木材通过了船闸。

entries.en: The baker decorated the cake with candied orange peel.
entries.zh: 面包师用糖渍橙皮装饰蛋糕。

entries.en: I saved the individually wrapped candy bar for the long bus ride.
entries.zh: 我把那块单独包装的块状糖果留着，准备在长途公交旅程中吃。

entries.en: The antiwar novel depicts young soldiers treated as cannon fodder.
entries.zh: 这部反战小说描写了被当作炮灰的年轻士兵。

entries.en: Guests waited beneath the canopied entrance while the rain fell.
entries.zh: 下雨时，宾客们在有天篷遮盖的入口处等候。

entries.en: The horse settled into a smooth canter along the field.
entries.zh: 马沿着田地进入了平稳的慢跑节奏。

entries.en: The guide told a captivating story about the abandoned lighthouse.
entries.zh: 导游讲了一个关于废弃灯塔的迷人故事。

entries.en: Their first attempt at caravanning ended beside a flooded campsite.
entries.zh: 他们第一次乘旅行拖车度假，在一处被淹的营地旁结束了。

entries.en: The archive kept a carbon copy of the original letter.
entries.zh: 档案馆保存了一份原信的复写副本。

entries.en: The archaeologists sent a charcoal sample for carbon dating.
entries.zh: 考古学家将一份木炭样本送去做碳十四测年。

entries.en: The waiter offered still or carbonated water with the meal.
entries.zh: 服务员询问用餐配不含气的水还是碳酸水。

entries.en: The librarian searched the old card index for the missing volume.
entries.zh: 图书管理员在旧卡片索引中查找遗失的那一卷。

entries.en: The case archive includes a report documenting a cardiac arrest.
entries.zh: 病例档案中有一份记录心搏停止事件的报告。

entries.en: The lesson distinguishes a cardinal number from an ordinal number.
entries.zh: 这节课区分了基数和序数。

entries.en: A caring neighbor checked whether the elderly resident needed groceries.
entries.zh: 一位关怀他人的邻居询问那位年长住户是否需要杂货。

entries.en: The witness described the carjacking in a recorded interview.
entries.zh: 目击者在录音访谈中描述了那起劫车事件。

entries.en: The teaching model marks the carotid artery with a red label.
entries.zh: 教学模型用红色标签标出了颈动脉。

entries.en: A man's worn felt carpet slipper lay beside the old armchair.
entries.zh: 一只破旧的绒毡男用室内拖鞋放在旧扶手椅旁。

entries.en: The shopkeeper placed the books in a thick paper carrier bag.
entries.zh: 店主把书装进了厚纸购物手提袋。

entries.en: The curator gave the designer carte blanche over the entrance display.
entries.zh: 策展人全权委托设计师负责入口展陈。

entries.en: The cartoon strip tells its story without a single spoken word.
entries.zh: 这组连环漫画不用一句对白就讲述了故事。

entries.en: The developers proposed to carve up the property into smaller plots.
entries.zh: 开发商提议将这片地产划分成较小的地块。

entries.en: A small wooden carving stood beside the guest book.
entries.zh: 一件小木雕立在留言簿旁。

entries.en: The cook placed the carving knife beside the roast.
entries.zh: 厨师把切肉餐刀放在烤肉旁。

entries.en: The successful puzzle series became the publisher's cash cow.
entries.zh: 那套成功的益智读物成了出版商的摇钱树。

entries.en: The nearest cash dispenser was inside the railway station.
entries.zh: 最近的自动取款机在火车站里。

entries.en: She went to the bank to cash in the savings certificates.
entries.zh: 她去银行兑现储蓄凭证。

entries.en: The old cash register rang whenever its drawer opened.
entries.zh: 那台旧收银机每次抽屉打开都会响。
